fields.description: The id of the payment gateway as WooCommerce has it, for example bacs
fields.label: WooCommerce Payment Method

fields.description: An order paid with this method is imported with a submitted Sales Invoice and a Payment Entry on the default account of this Mode of Payment. Left empty, its orders are skipped.
fields.label: Mode of Payment

fields.description: The company's Bank Account the money went to. It must be on the account the Mode of Payment books on. Empty for cash.
fields.label: Bank Account

fields.description: When the invoice and payment of an order paid this way are dated. When Paid: when WooCommerce took the order as paid, which for cash on delivery is at checkout. When Completed: when the order was set to completed, for money that comes in later, such as a transfer for a reserved product or cash the courier collects.
fields.label: Payment Date
